design_overview: A modern, production-ready inventory management system designed for mobile-first interaction with emphasis on speed, clarity, and real-time data visibility. The interface prioritizes quick barcode scanning, instant inventory updates, and proactive low-stock alerts. The design uses a clean card-based layout with strong visual hierarchy, ensuring store clerks can perform tasks efficiently while managers gain actionable insights through clear data presentation and reporting tools.

typography.font_family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

screens.name: Dashboard Home
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen showing inventory overview, quick actions, and critical alerts at a glance

key_components.name: Top Header Bar
key_components.styling: White background with subtle bottom shadow, contains app title 'Inventory Manager' in bold text and notification bell icon on right
key_components.interaction: Bell icon navigates to Alerts screen, shows red badge if unread alerts exist

key_components.name: Welcome Card
key_components.styling: Rounded card with subtle gradient from primary to lighter blue, white text, displays user name and role with greeting
key_components.interaction: Static display, no interaction

key_components.name: Quick Stats Grid
key_components.styling: Three-column grid of stat cards showing Total Products, Low Stock Items, and Today's Transactions with large numbers and small labels
key_components.interaction: Each stat card taps to navigate to filtered view of that category

key_components.name: Scan Product Button
key_components.styling: Large primary blue button with camera icon, rounded corners, prominent shadow, white text reading 'Scan Barcode'
key_components.interaction: Opens camera scanner interface for barcode scanning

key_components.name: Recent Activity List
key_components.styling: White card container with header 'Recent Activity', shows 5 recent transactions with product name, quantity change, and timestamp
key_components.interaction: Each list item taps to show transaction details

key_components.name: Low Stock Alert Banner
key_components.styling: Warning-colored banner with orange background, white text, shows count of low stock items with warning icon
key_components.interaction: Taps to navigate to Low Stock Alerts screen

key_components.name: Quick Actions Row
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable row of action cards: Add Product, View Reports, Manage Suppliers, each with icon and label
key_components.interaction: Each card navigates to respective feature screen

key_components.name: Inventory Summary Card
key_components.styling: White card showing total inventory value, items in stock, and out of stock count with subtle dividers
key_components.interaction: Taps to navigate to full inventory list

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar with 5 navigation items: Home, Scan, Alerts, Reports, Settings, each with icon and label, active item highlighted in primary blue
key_components.interaction: Each icon navigates to corresponding main screen

screens.user_flow: Entry point after login. Users can quickly scan products, view alerts, check stats, or navigate to other sections via bottom nav or quick action cards.

screens.name: Barcode Scanner
screens.purpose: Camera-based barcode scanning interface for quick product lookup and inventory updates

key_components.name: Scanner Header
key_components.styling: Semi-transparent dark overlay with white text 'Scan Barcode' and back button on left
key_components.interaction: Back button returns to previous screen

key_components.name: Camera Viewfinder
key_components.styling: Full-screen camera feed with centered scanning reticle overlay showing green targeting box
key_components.interaction: Automatically scans when barcode detected within reticle

key_components.name: Scanning Guide Text
key_components.styling: Semi-transparent white card with dark text reading 'Align barcode within frame' positioned below reticle
key_components.interaction: Static instructional text

key_components.name: Flash Toggle Button
key_components.styling: Circular button with flashlight icon in top-right corner, white background with subtle shadow
key_components.interaction: Toggles camera flash on/off for low-light scanning

key_components.name: Manual Entry Button
key_components.styling: Secondary button with white background, primary blue text reading 'Enter Barcode Manually'
key_components.interaction: Opens modal with numeric keypad for manual barcode entry

key_components.name: Scan Result Card
key_components.styling: Slides up from bottom when scan successful, white card with product image, name, current stock, and action buttons
key_components.interaction: Shows product details with options to Update Stock, View Details, or Scan Another

key_components.name: Product Image Thumbnail
key_components.styling: Square product image with rounded corners inside scan result card
key_components.interaction: Taps to view full product details

key_components.name: Stock Quantity Display
key_components.styling: Highlighted text showing current quantity with label, uses success green if adequate stock, warning orange if low
key_components.interaction: Static display within scan result

key_components.name: Update Stock Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button with white text 'Update Stock', full width within result card
key_components.interaction: Opens quantity adjustment interface with plus/minus controls

key_components.name: Error Message Banner
key_components.styling: Red background card with white text and error icon, appears when barcode not found
key_components.interaction: Displays error message with option to try again or add new product

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Dashboard via Scan button or bottom nav. User points camera at barcode, system auto-scans and displays product card. User can update stock, view details, or continue scanning. Back button returns to Dashboard.

screens.name: Low Stock Alerts
screens.purpose: Displays all active low stock and out-of-stock alerts with ability to mark as read and take action

key_components.name: Alerts Header
key_components.styling: White background with title 'Stock Alerts', back button on left, filter icon on right
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Dashboard, filter icon opens alert type filter menu

key_components.name: Alert Summary Card
key_components.styling: Warning-colored card showing total unread alerts count with icon, subtle gradient background
key_components.interaction: Static summary display

key_components.name: Filter Tabs
key_components.styling: Horizontal tab bar with three options: All, Low Stock, Out of Stock, active tab underlined in primary blue
key_components.interaction: Tapping each tab filters alert list to show only that category

key_components.name: Alert List
key_components.styling: Scrollable list of alert cards, each showing product name, current quantity, threshold, timestamp, and unread indicator dot
key_components.interaction: Each alert card taps to show product details and reorder options

key_components.name: Alert Item Card
key_components.styling: White card with left border colored by severity (orange for low, red for out), product thumbnail on left, details on right, swipe actions enabled
key_components.interaction: Tap opens product details, swipe left reveals Mark as Read and Reorder actions

key_components.name: Product Thumbnail
key_components.styling: Small square product image with rounded corners on left side of alert card
key_components.interaction: Part of tappable alert card

key_components.name: Quantity Badge
key_components.styling: Small pill-shaped badge showing current stock number, colored red if zero, orange if below threshold
key_components.interaction: Static display within alert card

key_components.name: Mark All Read Button
key_components.styling: Secondary button with border, positioned above bottom nav, text reads 'Mark All as Read'
key_components.interaction: Marks all visible alerts as read and removes unread indicators

key_components.name: Reorder Action Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button within expanded alert card, text reads 'Reorder Now'
key_components.interaction: Opens supplier contact or reorder form for selected product

key_components.name: Empty State Card
key_components.styling: Centered card with success icon and text 'All stock levels are healthy!' shown when no alerts exist
key_components.interaction: Static display when alert list is empty

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Dashboard alert banner or bottom nav. Users view alerts, filter by type, tap alerts to see product details, swipe to mark read or reorder. Back button returns to Dashboard.

screens.name: Product Details
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of individual product information with inventory management and transaction history

key_components.name: Product Header
key_components.styling: White background with back button on left, edit icon on right, product name as title
key_components.interaction: Back returns to previous screen, edit icon opens product editing form

key_components.name: Product Image Hero
key_components.styling: Large product image with subtle shadow, centered, takes up top third of screen with white background
key_components.interaction: Taps to view full-screen image gallery

key_components.name: Product Info Card
key_components.styling: White card with product name, barcode, price, cost, and supplier information in organized rows with labels
key_components.interaction: Static information display, supplier name taps to view supplier details

key_components.name: Stock Status Card
key_components.styling: Highlighted card showing current quantity with large number, low stock threshold, and last restocked date, colored by stock level
key_components.interaction: Static display with visual status indicator

key_components.name: Adjust Stock Section

key_components.interaction: Plus/minus buttons adjust quantity, transaction type dropdown selects sale/restock/adjustment, save button commits change

key_components.name: Transaction Type Selector

key_components.name: Save Stock Update Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button with white text 'Save Update', full width within adjustment card

key_components.name: Transaction History List
key_components.styling: White card with header 'Recent Transactions', scrollable list showing last 10 transactions with type, quantity, user, and timestamp
key_components.interaction: Each transaction item taps to show full transaction details

key_components.name: Set Alert Threshold Button
key_components.styling: Secondary button with border, text reads 'Set Low Stock Alert', positioned below stock status
key_components.interaction: Opens modal to adjust low stock threshold value

key_components.name: Delete Product Button

key_components.interaction: Shows confirmation dialog before permanently removing product from system

screens.user_flow: Accessed from scan results, alert cards, or inventory list. Users view complete product info, adjust stock levels, set thresholds, view transaction history, or edit details. Back button returns to previous screen.

screens.name: Sales Reports

key_components.name: Revenue Summary Card

key_components.name: Sales Trend Chart

key_components.name: Top Products Section

key_components.interaction: Each product card taps to navigate to product details

key_components.name: Top Product Card

key_components.interaction: Taps to view full product details and sales breakdown

key_components.name: Inventory Turnover Card

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Dashboard quick actions or bottom nav. Users select date range, view sales analytics and charts, explore top products, and export reports. Back button returns to Dashboard.

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. All touch targets meet minimum 44x44px accessibility standards. Cards and lists use flexible layouts that adapt to screen width. Bottom navigation remains fixed and accessible. Landscape mode supported with adjusted layouts. Tablet views use two-column layouts where appropriate. Web version uses responsive breakpoints: mobile (<768px), tablet (768-1024px), desktop (>1024px).
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios meet 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. All icons paired with text labels. Form inputs include visible labels and placeholders. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Keyboard navigation supported on web. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Error messages clearly associated with form fields. Alternative text provided for all images.
animations: Subtle, purposeful animations enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations. Button presses show 100ms scale feedback (0.95x). Modal bottom sheets slide up with 250ms ease-out. List items fade in with staggered 50ms delays. Loading states use skeleton screens with subtle shimmer. Pull-to-refresh uses native platform animations. Toggle switches animate smoothly over 200ms. Chart data animates in over 400ms with easing. All animations respect system reduced-motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outline style for secondary actions, filled style for active/primary states. Icons sourced from system defaults (SF Symbols for iOS, Material Icons for Android). Common icons: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person outline), settings (gear), bell (notification bell), bookmark (bookmark outline), heart (heart outline), filter (funnel), plus (plus sign), edit (pencil), trash (trash bin), share (share arrow). Icons sized at 24x24px for navigation, 20x20px for inline use. All icons have 2px stroke weight for visual consistency.
